resources.string: Intensitate Quiet Ops o Vault Neon, accento neon e silentio de panico. Le superimpositiones de profilo pote superscriber los sin scriber al HOME del host in Portable Data.
Fortia Quiet Ops e cela bordos e indicatores neon. Solo visual — non cambia le paravento o le kill-switch. Accesso directe: Super+Shift+P.

Cata profilo con nomine pote conservar su proprie superposition desktop.properties pro intensitate, accento, icones e cursor. Le cambio recarga le apparentia ab le superposition del profilo, postea ab le proprietates global del camera forte.
Stilo de superposition Compose (quando XCursor non es disponibile)
Discargar themas de cursor (in icons portabile/coffro)
Non poteva discargar le thema de cursor: %1$s

Linux: le apps filia recipe XCURSOR_THEME e XCURSOR_SIZE. Telos carga quadros XCursor in un cursor AWT quando possibile; alteremente le superposition Compose Sweet/Breeze es designate. Sequentiales XCursor animate non es reproducite.
Windows: mappa a cursores de systema AWT. Themas XCursor/Plasma non es applicate al punctator Win32.
macOS: mappa a cursores de systema AWT. Themas XCursor/Plasma non es applicate al punctator Cocoa.

Paper Ops (light) by day and Quiet Ops (dark) by night when Auto is selected. Boundaries use your chosen timezone. Default is manual timezone — the network is never contacted for location unless you opt in below.
IANA timezone for local day/night (JVM default until you pick one). Manual selection never phones home.

Opt-in only. When enabled, Telos makes a one-shot request to a public IP→geo endpoint to learn timezone and country code. Only those values (and optional coordinates for sunrise/sunset) are stored in vault desktop.properties. Your IP is not logged, there is no continuous tracking, and themes are not synced to the cloud. If the network fails, kill-switch is on, or you are offline, Telos keeps your manual timezone and shows Preference only or Failed honestly.
Preference only — network assist off, blocked, or not requested; using manual timezone
Failed — could not reach the geo endpoint; keeping manual timezone
Index de nomines de file sur le dispositivo

Optional. Indexa solmente nomines de file sub le HOME del vault o le radice Portable Data (nunquam le profilo del host excepte Host Home). Immagazinate criptate sub .cache/telos/file-index con permissiones solmente del proprietario. Nulle contento de file e nulle cargamento al nube.
Nur vault kaj porteblaj radikoj — ne indeksas gastigan hejmon ekster la seanco.
Se applica al proxime initio de session Telos quando TELOS_COMPOSITOR non es definite. Super+flecha fixa le fenestra focalisate.
Themas de icones freedesktop pro scriptorio (non pacchettos ADW de Android).
In modo Portable Data, le pacchettos resta in le dossier portabile de icones (non in le profilo del hospite).
Salvate in le coffre. Sur Linux, Telos applica DoT via resolvectl quando disponibile; DoH resta solmente un preferentia.
Dossieres de profilo del coffre sub ~/.config/telos/profiles/
Applicate: le traffico de exito non autorisate es abandonate (nftables inet telos_session)
Preferentia salvate; non applicate sur iste platteforma
Activate, ma nftables non poteva esser applicate — le traffico non es blocate
Rader le firewall del session es blocate durante que le kill-switch es active

One desktop-id or package per line with allow, deny, or vpn. Stored under ~/.config/telos/app-routing.txt. On Linux, deny blocks launch in the Telos launcher and vpn sets TELOS_APP_ROUTE=vpn (best-effort, no fake netns). Process-level nftables owner/cgroup routing is not applied, so the session kill-switch stays intact.

Block and allow lists are stored under vault ~/.config/telos/ (dns-block.txt, dns-allow.txt). A NextDNS configuration ID applies DoT via resolvectl on Linux when available. Enable Telos DNS stub (or set dns-stub.port) to run a local 127.0.0.1 forwarder that NXDOMAINs blocked hosts and redirect DNS with nftables — then host lists become Enforced. If the stub cannot bind or nft fails, status stays Failed/PreferenceOnly. Windows and macOS store preferences only.
Invalid NextDNS configuration ID (use 4–12 letters or digits)
Enforced (NextDNS DoT and/or Telos DNS stub + nft redirect)
Preference saved; filtering is not applied on this path
Configured, but the DNS stub could not bind or resolvectl/nftables could not apply filtering
Enforced: launch-gate active (deny rules consulted by DesktopFileLauncher)
Preference saved; no deny rules on Linux, or not applied on this platform

Telos DNS stub listens on 127.0.0.1 (default port 5353), answers NXDOMAIN for dns-block.txt (allowlist wins), and forwards other queries. nftables inet telos_dns redirects outbound port 53 when privileged apply succeeds.
Calefa le schermo con un instrumento del hospite (gammastep, redshift o wlsunset). Sin servicios de localisation e nihil es inviate per le rete. Sin instrumento, solmente le preferentia es salvate.
Preferentia salvate; installa gammastep, redshift o wlsunset pro applicar sur iste hospite
Le instrumento del hospite non poteva cambiar le temperatura del schermo
Nulle configuration corresponde a iste cerca

Texto sensibile (claves, IBAN, WireGuard) es removite del historia, conservate solo in iste session, e nettate del area de transferentia del systema. Le historia resta local al vault — sin synchronisation in le nube.
Nettar le area de transferentia ora
Usque a 20 elementos · expira post 5 minutas · fixar usque al bloco · Super+V
Ancora nulle historia del area de transferentia
Registrar le instantanee de integritate del hospite
Summario local de digests PCR 0/7 via tpm2-tools quando presente. Isto non es attestation remote (RAP).

Automatic specimen le banda del fundo detra le pannello superior sur iste dispositivo e selige glyphes clar o obscur pro le icones Helix e le etiquettas StatusNotifier de Compose. Le pixeles remane local. Le pixmaps SNI de telos-sni non es recolorate. Preferentia: panel.iconContrast=auto|light|dark.
Flatpak non es disponibile; le substitutiones de permissiones non es disponibile sur iste systema.
Non poteva applicar le substitution Flatpak
telos:// aperi apps Telos e le cerca Kickoff (registrate al initio del scriptorio).
Winget/Scoop are Windows-only; this host stores no Windows package actions.
Neither winget nor scoop was found on PATH.
Records your request and asks xdg-desktop-portal when Device/Camera portals are available. Without portal tools this stays preference-only.
Preference saved; portal tools are not available (preference-only).
Portal device access is unavailable on this system.
Could not ask the desktop portal for device access
Per-app netns tools missing; isolation stays preference-only
Net-isolated Flatpak uses Flatpak --unshare=network (not a host netns claim).
Net-isolated tier set; host unshare/ip netns tools missing — Flatpak override only when Flatpak applies it.
Off by default. Also enabled with TELOS_SHOT_CLIPBOARD=1.
Draw a rectangle to black out private content, then save.
Saves under Pictures/Screenshots in the vault (or portable data), owner-only (0600).
Relative al puncto de montar del vault (p.ex. Pictures/wall.jpg). Nunquam monstrate sur le schermo pre-boot blocate.
Quiet Ops — disbloca pro revelar tu fondo
Le boot blocate resta in Quiet Ops solmente con le glifo del vault. Post disblocar, Telos face un crossfade al fondo del vault e le intensitate eligite — sin particulas.
Le color del anello de accento es solmente OpSec visual (Host = orange caution, Net-isolated = cyan, Vault FS = verde, Standard = magenta).
Un clic define un par GPL documentate (Papirus↔BreezeX, candy-icons↔Bibata; CandyCyber resta le glifo chrome integrate). Le discargamentos resta in le dossier de icones del vault o portable.
Transparente o confusate affecta solmente le radice del pannello; le menus resta opac. Confusate conserva panelBlur pro frost; le confusation del fundo del hospite es best-effort si non disponibile.
Le confusation del fundo del hospite non es disponibile; Telos usa un placa frost translucide e conserva tu preferentia de confusation.
Quiet Ops is the default. Vault Neon strengthens Cyber-Tech borders and HUD gauges. Paper Ops is a light daytime option. Popups stay opaque; there is no second blur.
Samples the vault or portable wallpaper on this device for a Material tonal seed. Nothing is uploaded.
Accentos neon subtil sub le digitos 1–4 del pannello. Celate durante panic mute. Disactivar: theme.workspaceTints=false.
Portable data folder (config, cache, temp only here)
Host Home writes settings and cache on this PC. Choose Portable Data to leave no host traces.
Portable Data — no host traces (config/cache/temp under portable root)
Portable Vault — encrypted data under portable root
Host Home (may leave traces on this PC)
Unlock existing vault (file or stego folder)
Create new elastic / stego / deniable vault
Importation automatic al initio quando un clave de sync es immagazinate
Replaces your user shell at next sign-in. Keep a recovery path before enabling.
Helix window chrome is drawn in Compose on all platforms; native Win32 decorations may show until shell replacement.
Pacchetto de sync de session importate
Clave de sync immagazinate pro importation al initio sin invitation
Insere un phrase secret de sync ante activar le importation automatic
Dossieres de profilo nominate sub config profiles/. Solo le nomine active in desktop.properties — nunquam contrasignos.
Ancora nulle profilos. Crea un pro cambiar identitates del coffre.
Usa litteras, numeros, punctos, sublineas o tractos de union (max. 64).
Le radices portabile mantene config, cache e temp foras del profilo hospite (predefinite Windows: Portable Data).
Cammino del dossier de coffre portabile
Le radice portabile non pote esser le domicilio hospite o su .config/.cache/.local.
Initia un servitor de accopulation breve sur le LAN. Scanna o entra le codice in Telos Sync. Codices e tokens nunquam es registrate.
Le servitor de accopulation ascolta sur le LAN
Non pote ligar un adresse public — usa un IP LAN private
Obtener pacchetto de session del scriptorio
Sur Android aperi Sync → Preferentias e colla le URI o entra host, porta e codice.
Restaura desktop.properties e ~/.config/telos ab un copia de reserva de session AES. Claves private WireGuard nunquam es scribite in registros. Require confirmation.
Preste a restaurar %1$s files de configuration Telos (desktop.properties: %2$s). Confirma pro applicar.
Configuration de session del vault restaurate

Copia una copia de seguridad telos_vault.img a la ruta de imagen portable/vault. El vault debe estar bloqueado. Nunca monta con contraseña: desbloquee por separado tras restaurar. Requiere confirmación y comprobación SHA-256.
Listo para restaurar %1$s bytes (sha256 %2$s…). Confirme para copiar. El vault debe seguir bloqueado.
Imagen LUKS restaurada como %1$s (sigue bloqueada — desbloquee por separado)
Se requiere confirmación para restaurar la imagen LUKS
El vault debe estar bloqueado antes de restaurar la imagen LUKS

Compruebe una ruta file:// local o un manifiesto HTTPS firmado con la clave Ed25519 de Telos. Las actualizaciones se preparan en portable/vault temp y nunca se instalan automáticamente. Canal predeterminado: recurso de GitHub Releases telos-desktop-update.manifest.
URL del manifiesto de GitHub Releases rellenada
Manifesto de actualisation (cammino, file:// o https://)
URL del manifesto de actualisation salveguardate
Actualisation signate %1$s verificate — confirma pro preparar le installation
Actualización preparada como %1$s — confirme el ayudante de reinicio (sustituir el jar en ejecución es de mejor esfuerzo)
Verification del signatura de actualisation fallite
Defini primo un URL de manifesto file:// o HTTPS
El ayudante de reinicio escribe un marcador de actualización pendiente y un script opcional de reemplazo, luego sale. Sustituir un jar JVM en ejecución es de mejor esfuerzo.
No se pudo preparar el ayudante de reinicio de actualización
Samplea le fundo vault o portable sur iste dispositivo e deriva localmente un semine tonal Material. Le pixeles nunquam es cargate. Si illo falli, le chrome usa cyan neon.
